rule: article = event anchored in Nouvelle-Aquitaine (regional flag or org department in the 12 NA codes); foreign = deterministic title language detection with at least 3 evidence points and confidence >= 0.3; translation = offline glossary, no network and no paid service; personal data = email or phone in the headline blocks translation; quality = 85% multiset content F1 against an independent French reference + 15% identifier preservation

sql.articles:
SELECT e.id::text AS id, e.title, e.regional, o.dept AS department, e.source_id
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN org o ON o.id = e.org_id
   WHERE e.regional OR o.dept IN ('16', '17', '19', '23', '24', '33', '40', '47', '64', '79', '86', '87')
   ORDER BY e.id
sql.baseline:
SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM org) AS organizations,
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM source) AS sources,
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM event) AS events
